name: Run Out of Blood
source:
Rebecca returns home after a long trip, but all her plans are ruined by unforeseen circumstances. She turns to a family living in the woods for help...
Now all she wants to do is just run out of... here.

Run Out of Blood is a slow-burn gore novel with narration from the protagonist's POV. Help Rebecca survive, or see what happens if you behave recklessly.
